shared: experiments/configs/samedata_common.json (candidates c1-c3, protocol templates, selection/comparison rule, multiplicity, exit triggers)
usable: yes: same rows, exact published script and split, and a source-paper column for P2.

source.paper: Chen Z., ..., Yu Y., Liu L.X. Chem. Eng. J. 455 (2023) 140547, doi:10.1016/j.cej.2022.140547 (Nanjing Tech / Univ. of Surrey)

target: LOI (%), epoxy + organic P-containing FRs (literature data, 'over 300 papers')

rows.exclusions: none, as in the paper. The 7 exact duplicate rows stay (the paper kept them).
rows.do_not_use: GitHub LOI_Database.csv (284 descriptors; not the paper's input).

groups_for_P2.rule (label-free): column DOI forward-filled in file order; row i of mmc4 belongs to row i of mmc5.
groups_for_P2.assert_before_any_fit: mmc4 'LOI' and 'Addition amount (wt%)' equal mmc5 'LOI' and 'addition amount (wt%)' on all 1053 rows (checked 2026-10-07: true) and 254 distinct DOIs; otherwise BLOCKED.

features: all 306 columns of mmc5 except LOI (305 alvaDesc descriptors + 'addition amount (wt%)'), file order, float64. c1-c3 receive them raw; only r0 applies the paper's RFE + polynomial step inside each training part.

bar.set: single random hold-out test set, 263 rows (train 790)
bar.quote_protocol: "First, the database was randomly divided into training set and test set according to the ratios of 75% and 25%."
bar.quote_result: "The coefficient of determination (R2) scores for the training and test sets are 0.844 (790 data points) and 0.642 (263 data points), respectively."
bar.where_read: University of Surrey accepted manuscript (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), Section 2.2 and the Fig. 3 text; 0.642 also in the abstract; SI Table S3 (GBR test 0.642; RandomForest 0.600) and Table S4 (polynomial degree 2: 0.642).
bar.best_model: GradientBoostingRegressor after StandardScaler, RFE (Ridge inner estimator, 100 features kept per SI Table S1) and degree-2 polynomial features; 13 regressors compared in SI Table S3.
bar.exact_split_source: publisher SI mmc6.zip main.py: train_test_split(X, y, random_state=1) with default test_size 0.25 -> 263 test rows, matching the paper.
bar.verification: fulltext (author manuscript) + publisher SI script; numbers and split agree.
bar.not_a_bar: 5- and 10-fold CV test R2 0.574 / 0.575 (SI Table S2). The paper says only "After 5 and 10 cross-validations by default" and no CV code was released, so fold assignment and refitting of the selection step are unknown. Printed for context, never compared.

r0 (reproduction control).definition: fit on the training part only: StandardScaler() -> RFE(Ridge(alpha=1, random_state=1, max_iter=100000), n_features_to_select=100) -> PolynomialFeatures(degree=2) -> GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=1) (all other arguments sklearn defaults: 100 trees, depth 3, lr 0.1).
r0 (reproduction control).source: SI main.py (loops collapse to features=100, alpha=1, degree=2; the n_estimators/max_depth loop variables are not passed to the regressor).

reproduction_gate: r0 on P1_pub must give test R2 in [0.637, 0.647] (authors used 2022-era scikit-learn; we run 1.7.1). Outside -> FLAG 'Chen protocol not reproduced': no P1 sentence for this dataset; P2 still runs and is reported.

protocols.P1_pub: train_test_split(X, y, random_state=1) (test_size default 0.25). r0 = gate; c1-c3 printed as information only.
protocols.P1: train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=s), s = 0..9 (no stratification, as theirs). Test R2 (primary), RMSE, MAE. Mean, SD, s=0 value for c1, c2, c3, r0.
protocols.P2: common P2 with groups = forward-filled DOI (254 papers). r0 included.

notes: Random splits leak: 306 molecules over 1053 rows, so most test molecules also sit in training at other loadings. P1 is their protocol, kept on purpose; P2 removes paper-level leakage, not molecule-level leakage (9 descriptor vectors appear under more than one DOI).
The published single split is seed 1; P1 uses seeds 0..9 and therefore includes seed 1.
r0's polynomial step makes 5,151 features; expect r0 to dominate runtime (RFE: 206 Ridge refits per split).
